Compatibility incident: dedup. Two supported consumer builds have independent archived behavior. A drop-in Python function is being prepared for the build named by the pending route check.

  repair(["a","c","f"]) -> ["a","c","f"] on both
  repair(["b"]) -> ["b"] on both
Probe 2: archive replay from birch:
  repair(["z","r","z","t"]) -> ["z","r","t"]
  repair(["x","y","x"]) -> ["x","y"]
Probe 3: archive replay from alder:
  repair(["z","r","z","t"]) -> ["r","z","t"]
  repair(["x","y","x"]) -> ["y","x"]
Probe 4: current checkout on the same capture inputs:
  repair(["z","r","z","t"]) -> ["r","t","z"]
  repair(["x","y","x"]) -> ["x","y"]
Engineer: Source and smoke cases above are from the same checkout. No patch applied. Current diagnosis remains an alder compatibility regression. Await request routing trace.
